subject: English Home Language

show.line: Let's write v. Slide down, then slide up. Like a valley! v, v, van.

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says v, as in van.
This letter says v. Say the sound!
Trace v with your finger. Slide down, then slide up.
Listen with your ears. Which one starts with v?
Look with your eyes. Which one is v?

hints: v has one point at the bottom.
Start at the top. Down, then up.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write v.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Down, up, down, up. Look, I wrote v!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is w. v goes down and up only once.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Down, then up. Just once. That is v!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter v, say its sound and trace it.
